title: Dairy Fans
short: Heavy-duty steel drum fans, manufactured by us for cattle sheds.
shortUr: مویشی شیڈ کے لیے ہماری اپنی تیار کردہ مضبوط اسٹیل ڈرم فین۔
description: Khaleeq Dairy Fans are manufactured in-house: a powder-coated steel drum, wire guard, three-blade rotor and a direct-mounted electric motor. Built to move large volumes of air across the shed and keep cattle comfortable.

title: Dairy Fan Installation
short: On-site installation in your shed: positioning, mounting and wiring.
shortUr: آپ کے شیڈ میں فین کی تنصیب: جگہ کا تعین، ماؤنٹنگ اور وائرنگ۔
description: We do not just sell fans. Our team surveys the shed, decides the fan positions and angles, mounts the fans on columns or trusses and connects them to the control system.

title: Electrical Wiring
short: Complete farm and shed wiring for fans, lights, pumps and machines.
shortUr: فارم اور شیڈ کی مکمل وائرنگ۔
description: Safe, tidy and serviceable wiring for the whole farm: sheds, milking parlour, pumps and lighting.

title: Panel Boards
short: Control and distribution panels built for farm loads.
shortUr: فارم کے لوڈ کے مطابق کنٹرول اور ڈسٹری بیوشن پینل۔
description: Panel boards that group and protect fan, shower and pump circuits so the farm can be operated from one place.

title: Milking Parlour Systems
short: Milking parlour equipment and its supporting systems.
shortUr: ملکنگ پارلر کا سامان اور متعلقہ نظام۔
description: Equipment and supporting installation for milking parlours, including vacuum, electrical and control requirements.

title: Auto / Manual Control Systems
short: Automatic and manual switching for fans, showers and pumps.
shortUr: فین، شاور اور پمپ کے لیے خودکار اور دستی سوئچنگ۔
description: Control systems that let you run fans, showers and pumps automatically or by hand, with a clear selector at the panel.
points: Easy for farm staff to operate

title: Showering Systems
short: Cattle cooling showers and misting lines.
shortUr: مویشیوں کو ٹھنڈا رکھنے کے لیے شاور اور مسٹنگ لائنیں۔
description: Shower and misting lines that wet the cattle while the fans move air over them, cooling them down in hot weather.

title: Milking Machine Spare Parts
short: Spare parts to keep your milking machines running.
shortUr: ملکنگ مشین چلتی رکھنے کے لیے اسپیئر پارٹس۔
description: Spare parts for milking machines, so a small fault does not stop milking.
points: Ask us for a specific part

title: Vacuum Pumps
short: Vacuum pumps and related equipment for milking.
shortUr: ملکنگ کے لیے ویکیوم پمپ اور متعلقہ سامان۔
description: Vacuum pumps and related equipment for milking machines and parlours.
